device.title: Connect your assistant to Paperclip
device.codeLabel: Enter the code shown by your assistant
device.approvedBody: Return to your assistant. It will finish connecting automatically.
device.declinedBody: No access was granted. You can start a new connection from your assistant.
device.confirmMatches: Confirm this matches the code shown by your assistant:

startNew: Start a new connection from your assistant.

dot.intro: Enter the one-use code from Paperclip’s agent setup to review this connection’s access. Keep the code out of Bot chat. Access is granted only when you approve the named agent below.
dot.allowAs: Allow this connection to work as {{agent}} in {{company}}.
dot.scopeDescription: Connect Dot as a Paperclip agent. Pair it with an agent after connecting; assigned work uses that agent’s permissions.

orgUnavailable: The selected organization is no longer available to this account. Cancel and reconnect from your assistant to choose an organization you can access.
noOrganizations: This account has no available organizations. Ask an organization owner to add you, then reconnect from your assistant.
readAll: Read all of your Paperclip data
writeAll: Write all of your Paperclip data
readOnlyRole: Your role in this organization is read-only.

connections.title: Assistant connections
connections.description: Revoking a connection stops its future tool calls. Work already delegated continues under your organization’s normal controls.
